title: check:id-collisions spent one REST call per other open PR on every run, so a busy hour emptied the token's quota and redded PRs on a listing 403; the other PRs are now read through git and a run costs one REST call

source.ref: PR #3079 checks job 109645795505 (run 36638774356), 2026-09-29 22:30Z: GET pulls (page 1): HTTP 403, x-ratelimit-remaining: 0, x-ratelimit-resource: core; owner: change the rule so this stops jamming PRs

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1668). MEASURED FAILURE: #3079's required checks job went red only because check:id-collisions' cross-PR arm got GET pulls (page 1): HTTP 403 with x-ratelimit-remaining: 0 and x-ratelimit-resource: core, the PRIMARY hourly quota of the repository GITHUB_TOKEN (1,000 requests an hour), resetting 22 minutes later, so the HYG-133 five-minute retry budget could not outlast it. Premise re-tested on main at a5bb99b01: compare() called listPullRequestFiles once per other open PR, plus a contents download per watched file a PR touched, so with ~20 open PRs each run spent 21+ requests and every push and update-branch paid again (the same shape as #3011 and #3017 under HYG-133).

WHAT CLOSED IT. The ONE pulls listing stays. Every other PR's head is fetched in one git fetch --depth=1 --filter=blob:none of refs/pull/<n>/head into refs/id-collisions/pr/<n> (measured on a depth-1 checkout of main: 21 heads in 1.0s, a 133 KB pack, main's deepened history for check:shipped-ids unchanged); fragment ids come from git ls-tree names under docs/ledger; the two legacy files are read with git cat-file only when their blob differs from the base tip's, once per distinct blob (stale PRs share one), then base ids are subtracted as before. Git spends no REST quota. If the one fetch fails each head is fetched alone; a PR whose head git cannot read falls back to the old REST path for that PR only, and when that fails too the run fails (could-not-look stays red, never skip = clean). REST cost per run: 1 + N files listings (+ downloads) before, 1 after. The git seam is injected in scripts/check-id-collisions.test.ts (no network). .github/workflows/ci.yml needed no permission change (the fetch uses the checkout's contents: read credential); its comments now say git.

verify.note: Runs the real main() with an injected git seam and a counting fetch, no network. Arm 1: three other open PRs readable through git cost exactly one REST call, the pulls listing (on main at a5bb99b01 it spends 8: base contents reads plus one files listing per PR). Arm 2: a PR whose head git cannot fetch is read through the REST files listing, that PR alone. Arm 3: when git and the REST fallback both fail the run rejects rather than answering clean. Each arm was mutation-fired (always-REST, skip-on-git-failure, swallowed REST failure).
